name: Specter
summary: Specter provides AI-powered startup data and deal-sourcing tools for investors. Its platform tracks private companies, people, funding and M&A events, while its own financing remains undisclosed.
overview: Specter is a private-market intelligence platform used for company discovery and deal sourcing. It turns changes in company, funding, people and transaction data into investor signals.

intelligence.description: Private-market intelligence and deal-sourcing platform for investors.
company: Specter offers a private-company database and sourcing platform for investors. It monitors company, people, funding and M&A changes and presents them as signals intended to surface relevant opportunities earlier.

The company says its data covers more than 55 million companies, 550 million people, 330,000 investors and one million transactions. No confirmed financing amount or valuation is publicly disclosed, so the profile does not infer one.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Better private-company discovery tools can change the timing and quality of venture sourcing. The critical diligence questions are data accuracy, workflow adoption and defensibility against larger information providers.

changed.text: Profile reviewed against available public information.

takeaways: Specter is a private-market data and deal-sourcing platform.
No confirmed public financing or valuation has been identified.
Data quality and investor workflow adoption are the important proof points.
